title: CCNA / CyberOps | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: CCNA / CyberOps. Category: Networking. Duration: 2 months. Description: An introduction to how networks work, covering architectures, models, protocols, and networking elements needed to support small and large organizations. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
